operations.title: Benincasa reports the blockwise anatomy of the strict residual module
operations.body: Exact audit of Entry 1060's 81 labelled residual columns: normal block 0 contains 80 labels and carries the full transverse ranks rank(T1)=13, rank(T2)=13, rank(T1+T2)=26, intersection 0. Normal block 1 contains exactly one label and has rank profile (1,1,1), hence one shared line; it occurs only for source_basis_index=6 and the paired coefficient ratio T2/T1 is exactly 1. Normal block 2 is absent. Therefore the K5 adapter must not homogenize the normal blocks: it should preserve a transverse block-0 module plus one common block-1 attachment and certify that no block-2 label is silently manufactured. A lossless label/incidence manifest is being prepared at research/benincasa/triangle-wall-residual-adapter-manifest.json.

authority_basis.summary: Reporting a verified complementary result to the owner of the generalized K5 adapter.
